review: The existing remote request allowlist is unchanged. New attachmentOwner/list, prediction/request, gateway OAuth and experimental Bedrock routes remain denied. Prediction and OAuth events do not enable capabilities.

Goal set/clear add optional origin. The authenticated gateway stamps user actions as user and lifecycle pauses as automatic; callers cannot inject origin. Explicit Stop records user provenance. Legacy optional-field parsing remains compatible.

MessagePhase adds partial_answer. Existing clients retain its text as ordinary answer content without marking it final; turn/completed remains the completion signal. No UI or history payload migration is required.
Turn adds optional rootTurnId; turn/start adds optional parentTurnId and rootTurnId. The gateway does not request delegated work or enable internal subagents. Existing required fields are unchanged.
ResponseItem adds additional_tools. This does not grant tool execution permission: runtime dispatch still requires the audited remote-safe registry and unsupported tool calls remain denied.
Model provider capabilities remove namespaceTools on an unsupported route. ModelList field descriptions clarify future reasoning-effort values; existing model and effort wire fields are unchanged.
Skill paths retain string wire values via LegacyAppPathString. The managed catalog, exact projected directories and source validation remain enforced.

Thread item cursors accept item anchors and entries add optional timestamps. Item paging is outside the remote allowlist; history uses thread/read. Subagent activity adds optional model/effort metadata while internal subagents remain disabled.

CodexErrorInfo changes oneOf to anyOf and adds flexUnavailable/tooManyDenials, retaining existing variants. Misalignment reviewTarget and PlanType promax are metadata only; no continuation or approval permission is granted.

MCP discovery/resource/OAuth metadata, browser extension requirements, independent speed-mode support, environment skills/authBearerToken and realtime backendReasoningStatus are additive on unsupported routes. Existing gateway and remote policy do not expose them.

Compared the exact 0.163.0 stable and experimental snapshots with reviewed 0.162.1. Existing required fields are unchanged; the changes below are additive. Prior baseline-to-0.162.1 review remains applicable.

Thread list adds optional excludedThreadIds, which only narrows results. Experimental thread/read and thread/list add optional readState/readStates metadata. Existing per-user Workers, ownership checks and history parsing remain unchanged.

New thread/readState/update and thread/items/read methods remain outside the remote allowlist. A native boundary regression supplies valid required parameters and requires policy denial on this candidate. thread/readState/changed is metadata, not tool execution or Turn completion.

ResponseItem gains optional encrypted_content/status, and output text gains optional annotations/logprobs. These metadata fields do not grant local execution; remote dispatch still requires the audited safe registry. Turn completion remains turn/completed.

TurnToolOutput on turn/start gains optional retain (default false). It annotates supplied tool-output context for history retention, without executing a tool; existing clients omit it. New experimentalPredictionMode on thread/fork is on a denied route.
Expanded realtime voices, v3 voice lists and environment websocketRequestId are additive on unsupported routes. No realtime, environment, prediction, plugin or subagent capability is enabled.

This review binds only these exact source and schema hashes for Mac. Compilation, native probes, real model/device acceptance and publication are separate gates. Windows 0.163.0 is explicitly unreviewed.
